identity_description: Native nonblank string id, without coercion, hashing or guessed business composites.
limitations: POST JSON https://ifundboss-api.alipay.com/ivostro/api/clearingNetworkInfo/pageList.json; fixed pageNo=1/pageSize=1000. One unfiltered request only, no relation/detail query or speculative paging.

Response success must be boolean true; resultDataList contains rows and totalCount counts native unique identities. Exact integer page echoes are required; pageNo=0 is allowed only for empty rows and zero total with pageSize=1000.

1000 is a qualified fixed request width, not a measured maximum. SDK identity/count/capacity checks keep duplicate, conflicting or truncated responses incomplete; strict queries reject and incomplete refresh never publishes.

Full native records, unknown/nested fields, precise values, null, zero, empty strings and nested array order are retained; displayed records sort lexically by unmodified native string id. Timestamp units/timezone and unsupported detail semantics are not inferred.

Local matching uses exact whole strings: same field OR, different fields AND; missing/null never match. Blank inputs reject, valid values are not trimmed, commas are not split and * is literal. Local filters apply before output offset/limit/projection and are never sent to backend.
Live never publishes. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves saved data. No Get or new Duckdog import contract.

examples.title: Select Singapore or United States locally
